async def callbacks(items, register, session, statuses):
    for item in items:

        async def callback():
            async with session.get(item) as response:
                statuses.append(response.status)

        register(callback)
    while True:
        async with session():
            for item in items:

                async def callback():
                    async with session.lock():
                        statuses.append(item)

                register(callback)
        break
